title: 학생군사교육실시령 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Wearing Military Uniform)
① Military uniforms may be required to be worn by reserve officers and candidates in the officer training program, as stipulated in Article 10, paragraph 1, under the following circumstances: <amended November 29, 2016>
1. During military training
2. During examinations or inspections
3. When entering and leaving military training facilities
② When a reserve officer wears a military uniform, as stipulated in Article 1, they must wear the rank insignia and reserve officer emblem that were in effect at the time of their discharge.
